excludedFromThisProfile.shortFloorCabinet: New 1DW Floor-Mount Short Cabinet (docx P1097, P1110): no size, SKU or 3D model, and the price list has no 1DW cabinet. Waits for UFS-SIZ-01.
excludedFromThisProfile.lowerTop: Countertop of the short cabinet (P1113 -> P0861) and the decorative top of an uncovered lower cabinet: UFS-SIZ-01, UFS-TOP-01, GEN-SKU-03.
excludedFromThisProfile.handleGrooveColor: Not in the Master File, although the price list SKU carries HDL-{material}-{colour}; open question to the client.
excludedFromThisProfile.grainDirectionAndBookMatching: Not offered until the client answers GEN-STY-01.
excludedFromThisProfile.undermount: Not offered: the client has no undermount "currently" (GEN-TOP-15).
excludedFromThisProfile.thinThickness: Thin countertops only (P1133). Only 1/2" is confirmed (Fenix, HPL: table 438). Porcelain 3/8" or 1/2" waits for GEN-TOP-05; the Solid-Surface token for GEN-MAT-01.
excludedFromThisProfile.solidSurfaceBasin: Solid-Surface: Rectangular has no row in table 438; it is the Urban Standard Height candidate Top_Tekorlux_Rectangular until GEN-MAT-01.
excludedFromThisProfile.vesselSinks: The Master File lists no vessel sinks; only the vessel cutout is offered until the list is confirmed.
excludedFromThisProfile.sidePanelAvailability: Side panels are as tall as the cabinet body without the plinth and come in two heights (P1125, Block2 Q0050). Their SKUs and allowed grooves wait for UFS-SP-01; until then Urban Freestanding offers the panels Urban Low Height offers (team, 2026-10-07): no groove or one upper groove beside an Upper or Central Groove cabinet (91 cm), no groove beside a Push-to-Open one (88 cm), none beside an open shelf. A Central Groove cabinet starts with the panel without a groove, as Urban Low Height has no central groove to follow.
excludedFromThisProfile.heightsAndDepths: Heights 91H (Upper/Central Groove) and 88H (Push-to-Open), each with a 3 cm plinth, and depths 50/46 are in the cabinet table. The scene registers UF-sink-cabinet and UF-side-cabinet at 88/82 and 45/50.
excludedFromThisProfile.openShelves: Open Shelf 25/35/50 cm and Open Side Shelf 15 cm (price list) are in the cabinet table at their height with the 3 cm plinth: the 88H shelf as 91 next to Upper/Central Groove cabinets, the 85H shelf and the Open Side Shelf as 88 next to Push-to-Open, as the docs propose until UFS-SIZ-02. Hidden until the scene has their products; their SKU height is the table height less the plinth.
